item.title: Tropical Hypothermia
item.description: by Anonymous Why is it that when I get on a bus on a hot day all the windows are closed and the AC is off? The Sun is beating down on me and I am sweltering. No one else seems to care. Conversely, whenever it's cold and wet outside, half the windows are open, the heat is off, and I'm freezing. No one else seems to mind.
